Subject: INTERNAL: SpruceTech invite 403 — troubleshooting steps / logs needed

Ben/Laura — forwarding the thread from SpruceTech. Quick triage notes:

What happened: external user reports invite link returns a page saying "Invite token invalid or expired". Happen intermittently across browsers.
Why we think it's our side: the token is a base64-signed blob and we've seen cases where LB or CDN gzip/deflate compression and certain intermediate proxies rewrite '+' or '=' or trim trailing padding when URL encoding isn't preserved, resulting in token validation failure.

Action items:
- Ben: can you check the gateway logs around 2026-06-09T16:00:00Z and filter for requests to /invite/accept for host portal.redwood.ai? Look for any 4xx returned before our app receives the token, and any content-encoding or header mutations. Also check our link-shortener/redirect service for any double-encoding. Please drop the relevant 200/4xx request ids in invite-log.txt (attached).
- Laura: please reissue a one-time invite for steve.brooks@sprucetech.com with TTL 72h and enable the legacy-safe encoding flag so the link avoids URL-unfriendly characters. Add a note in the email asking them to try incognito and to paste the URL if they still see an error.

I attached a quick sample of what the malformed token looks like when padding is dropped (invite-log.txt). If we confirm a gateway rewrite, we should add an escape layer in the redirect service for signed tokens.

Thanks — this is high priority as they need to upload tax docs to start the PO process.

—Michael

Hi Steve — quick update and sorry for the friction.

We investigated the gateway logs and saw a small number of invite accept requests where the signed token was altered by an intermediate proxy. Ben confirmed the redirect service is now escaping the token payload and we reissued a new one-time invite to steve.brooks@sprucetech.com with a 72 hour TTL.

Please try the new link in the email titled "Redwood Supplier Portal: Activate your SpruceTech account" — if you still see the 403, please reply with the full (redacted) URL and a screenshot. We've also attached step-by-step instructions for manual activation to the email: new-invite-instructions.pdf (includes an alternate manual code entry flow if link activation fails).

Thanks for your patience — once you're in, Laura will walk you through the PO setup and where to upload your W-9.

Best,
